verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs say users can extend the built-in metrics with custom LLM-as-a-judge metrics, and a dedicated cookbook covers building domain-specific ones. Further configurability comes from global or project-scoped metrics, natural-language feedback that auto-tunes metrics, and running experiments against metrics of your choice; the free plan includes unlimited custom evals. missing for 10: specifics of judge configuration (judge-model selection, rubric/prompt and scoring-scale options) in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
